hunks.baseline: Muhammad Saladir ad-Din, the leader of a massive Islamic terrorist group, was momentarily taken aback.
hunks.sol: Muhammad Saladir ad-Din, leader of a massive Islamic terrorist group, was momentarily taken aback.

hunks.baseline: Who the hell was Hassan, and whose voice had just spoken in his bedroom, where no one else should have been?
hunks.sol: Who the hell was Hassan? And whose voice had just spoken in his bedroom, where no one else should have been?

hunks.baseline: But if he had been the kind of man who lost his composure over something this minor, he never would have risen to his current position.
hunks.sol: But if something this minor could make him lose his composure, he never would have risen to his current position.

hunks.baseline: Muhammad calmly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Muhammad answered calmly.

hunks.baseline: The uninvited guest emerged from the darkness, speaking flawless Arabic with not a syllable out of place. After confirming the man’s face, Muhammad narrowed his eyes.
hunks.sol: The uninvited guest emerged from the darkness, speaking flawless Arabic without a syllable out of place. When Muhammad saw the intruder’s face, he narrowed his eyes.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell? What is this strange bastard?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell? Who is this strange bastard?*

hunks.baseline: Although the man’s features were impossible to make out, the mask covering his face was bizarre enough on its own.
hunks.sol: The man’s features were impossible to make out, but the mask covering his face was bizarre enough on its own.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t a turban or a piece of cloth. It was made of thick red yarn, with gaping holes cut out for the eyes and mouth.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t a turban or a strip of cloth. It was made of thick red yarn, with gaping holes for his eyes and mouth.

hunks.baseline: Calling it a mask was strange enough, but Muhammad had never seen a lunatic wearing something like that in the middle of a scorching desert.
hunks.sol: Calling it a mask was strange enough. Muhammad had never seen a lunatic wear anything like it in the scorching desert.

hunks.baseline: He asked, unable to hide his confusion.
“Who are you?”
hunks.sol: “Who are you?” he asked.

hunks.baseline: A filial son was one thing, and a hand was another. So what the hell was a “filial son’s hand”[^2] supposed to be?
hunks.sol: A filial son was one thing, and a hand was another. What the hell was a “filial son’s hand”[^1] supposed to be?

hunks.baseline: [^2]: The Korean word *hyojason* literally means “a filial son’s hand” and refers to a back scratcher.
One thing, however, was certain: the strange man had not come to visit him in order to practice filial piety.
hunks.sol: One thing was certain: the man hadn’t come to practice filial piety.

hunks.baseline: Through the gaping hole in the mask, Muhammad could see the man’s lips curl slightly upward.
hunks.sol: Muhammad saw the corner of the man’s mouth lift through the hole in his mask.

hunks.baseline: “He told me to tell you this. He never told you to do any of that shit, so stop interpreting the scripture however the fuck you feel like.”
hunks.sol: “He told me to tell you he never ordered any of that shit, so stop interpreting the scripture however the fuck you want.”

hunks.baseline: “I never thought I’d live to hear a terrorist leader call me an insane bastard. What a shitty life.”
hunks.sol: “I never thought I’d live to hear a terrorist leader call me insane. What a shitty life.”

hunks.baseline: Muhammad solemnly opened his mouth while considering when to draw the scimitar at his waist.
hunks.sol: Muhammad considered when to draw the scimitar at his waist, then spoke with an air of authority.

hunks.baseline: “You foolish bastard. Do you really think you’ll get away with this?”
hunks.sol: “You fool. Do you really think you’ll get away with this?”

hunks.baseline: The strange man rummaged through his clothes before suddenly pulling something out of his sleeve and throwing it.
hunks.sol: The man rummaged through his clothes, then pulled something from his sleeve and tossed it.

hunks.baseline: With a fairly heavy sound, a round object came to rest at Muhammad’s feet.
hunks.sol: A round object landed with a heavy thud and rolled to Muhammad’s feet.

hunks.baseline: Healthy bronze skin, like that of a desert warrior, and eyes frozen wide open. Not a drop of blood stained the cleanly severed neck.
hunks.sol: Healthy bronze skin, like a desert warrior’s. Eyes frozen wide open. Not a drop of blood stained the cleanly severed neck.

hunks.baseline: “Why are you so surprised? Do you know the face?”
hunks.sol: “Why are you so surprised? Know him?”

hunks.baseline: Muhammad froze solid.
hunks.sol: Muhammad went cold.

hunks.baseline: Kasim had been the bodyguard and assassin he trusted more than anyone.
hunks.sol: Kasim was the bodyguard and assassin he trusted more than anyone.

hunks.baseline: An S-rank Hunter unknown to the world, Kasim was an awakened assassin whose victims were too numerous to count.
hunks.sol: An S-rank Hunter unknown to the world, Kasim was an Awakened assassin whose victims were too numerous to count.

hunks.baseline: *But he killed Kasim? And did it so quickly and secretly that no one noticed?*
hunks.sol: *He killed Kasim? So quickly and quietly that no one noticed?*

hunks.baseline: Fear seized his entire body, and Muhammad’s voice began to tremble.
hunks.sol: Fear gripped Muhammad’s entire body, and his voice trembled.

hunks.baseline: “I-I’ll give you one last chance. If you leave now, I’ll forget what happened today and take no revenge.”
hunks.sol: “I-I’ll give you one last chance. Leave now, and I’ll forget what happened today. There’ll be no retaliation.”

hunks.baseline: “N-No, dumbass. Why would I bother with all that when I can just kill you?”
hunks.sol: “N-No, dumbass. Why bother with all that when I can just kill you?”

hunks.baseline: “Diamonds? You mean the ones in the safe under your desk? I already took those. They were pretty.”
hunks.sol: “Diamonds? The ones in the safe under your desk? I already took those. They were pretty.”

hunks.baseline: *But nothing happened! Muhammad’s world went dark!*
hunks.sol: *But it had no effect! Muhammad’s world went dark!*

hunks.baseline: As Muhammad, having lost his composure, shouted the names like a scream, the strange man shouted along with him.
hunks.sol: Muhammad had lost his composure. As he screamed their names, the intruder called along with him.

hunks.baseline: How had all those heads come flying out of that narrow sleeve?
hunks.sol: How had all those heads come out of that narrow sleeve?

hunks.baseline: Muhammad was staring in horror at the three heads that had fallen one after another when—
hunks.sol: Muhammad stared in horror at the three heads that had fallen one after another. Then—

hunks.baseline: Despite the commotion inside the bedroom, the firmly closed door suddenly flew open. A huge man wearing the same kind of mask walked in and opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: The door, which had remained firmly shut despite the commotion in the bedroom, flew open. A huge man wearing the same kind of mask walked in.

hunks.baseline: The instant Muhammad saw the blood covering the giant’s hands, he froze like a statue. The strange man raised a hand in greeting.
hunks.sol: Blood soaked his hands. Muhammad froze like a statue, and the intruder raised a hand in greeting.

hunks.baseline: “There’s still work to do. But are you finished cleaning up?”
hunks.sol: “There’s still work to do. Are you finished cleaning up?”

hunks.baseline: “More or less. The other two are downstairs looking for this and that. By the way, can’t I take off this shitty mask? I’ve been suffocating in it.”
hunks.sol: “More or less. The other two are downstairs looking around. By the way, can’t I take off this shitty mask? I’ve been suffocating in it.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. Then at least let me smoke a cigar. My face is covered with illusion Magic anyway.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. Then at least let me smoke a cigar. My face is covered by illusion Magic anyway.”

hunks.baseline: “Why not wear your identification around your neck? And if you have even a shred of sense, wouldn’t you have accounted for illusion Magic? You’re already huge, and if you smoke a cigar with those skills, you’ll be practically advertising that you’re Chuck Hagel.”
hunks.sol: “Why not hang your ID around your neck? Anyone with half a brain would account for illusion Magic. You’re already huge, and with your skills, smoking a cigar would practically advertise that you’re Chuck Hagel.”

hunks.baseline: Muhammad’s eyes widened as he realized something.
hunks.sol: Muhammad’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: At the strange man’s startled reaction, Chuck Hagel pulled out a cigar and muttered,
hunks.sol: As the intruder recoiled in surprise, Chuck Hagel put a cigar between his teeth and muttered,

hunks.baseline: “...Crazy Korean.”
hunks.sol: “…Crazy Korean.”

hunks.baseline: But the person who really seemed about to lose his mind wasn’t Chuck Hagel. It was Muhammad himself.
hunks.sol: But Chuck Hagel wasn’t the one on the verge of losing his mind. Muhammad was.

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel’s name alone had been bad enough.
hunks.sol: As if the name Chuck Hagel hadn’t been enough, now he’d heard *Korean*.

hunks.baseline: But a Korean?
At this moment, Muhammad could not help thinking of the name of the most famous Korean in the world.
hunks.sol: He couldn’t help thinking of the most famous Korean in the world right now.

hunks.baseline: “D-Don’t give me that bullshit. Who do you think you’re fooling?”
hunks.sol: “D-Don’t give me that bullshit. Who do you think you’re fooling—”

hunks.baseline: The jeweled turban was sliced off, and even the few strands of hair remaining on Muhammad’s head were cut away as if erased.
hunks.sol: Muhammad’s jeweled turban flew off. Even the few strands of hair left on his head were cut away as if erased.

hunks.baseline: The strange man—or rather, Jin Taekyung—asked the frozen Muhammad, who had forgotten how to breathe.
hunks.sol: The intruder—no, Jin Taekyung—looked at Muhammad, who had forgotten to breathe.

hunks.baseline: “I-I was mistaken. I must have mistaken you!”
hunks.sol: “I was mistaken! I must have been!”

hunks.baseline: “How dare you swear by God and lie. I’m Jin Taekyung, you apostate bastard!”
hunks.sol: “How dare you swear by God and lie? I’m Jin Taekyung, you apostate bastard!”

hunks.baseline: Muhammad, seized by terror, screamed with all his strength. But the sound vanished without ever leaving the bedroom.
hunks.sol: Muhammad screamed with all his strength, but the sound vanished before it could leave the bedroom.

hunks.baseline: A barrier of qi created by magnificent internal energy had sealed the space without the slightest gap.
hunks.sol: A barrier of qi, formed from powerful internal energy, sealed the space without the slightest gap.

hunks.baseline: “Oh. Of course, there’s something you have to do before that.”
hunks.sol: “Oh. Of course, there’s something you need to do first.”

hunks.baseline: Muhammad never heard Chuck Hagel’s final words.

hunks.baseline: The meaning of what he had heard before already filled his mind to bursting.
hunks.sol: Muhammad didn’t hear Chuck Hagel’s last words. What he’d said before filled Muhammad’s mind to bursting.

hunks.baseline: Every human being thought about that word, but not Muhammad. He had always been the one who dealt death, never the one on the receiving end.
hunks.sol: Every human being thought about it. Muhammad never had—or at least, never as something that might happen to him. He had always dealt death, never received it.

hunks.baseline: He had joined an armed terrorist organization as a boy. He had held an automatic rifle instead of a pen, and after awakening, he had taken up a sword.
hunks.sol: He had joined an armed terrorist organization as a boy. Instead of a pen, he’d held an automatic rifle; after awakening, he’d taken up a sword.

hunks.baseline: Then, after rising through the ranks, he became the leader of a terrorist organization and kidnapped, imprisoned, and brutally executed countless people.
hunks.sol: He had risen through the ranks to lead a terrorist organization, kidnapping, imprisoning, and brutally executing countless people.

hunks.baseline: Muhammad, who shared a name with an ancient prophet, believed himself to be a new prophet and leader.
hunks.sol: Muhammad shared a name with the prophet of old. He believed himself a new prophet and leader.

hunks.baseline: But. But why?
hunks.sol: But then… why?

hunks.baseline: “I-I’m protected by God. How could this…”
hunks.sol: “I-I’m under God’s protection. How could this…”

hunks.baseline: The corners of Jin Taekyung’s mouth, which had been raised through the holes in his mask, slowly sank.
hunks.sol: The corner of Jin Taekyung’s mouth slowly fell. His voice turned cold.

hunks.baseline: His voice had grown cold.
“You’re a fucking lunatic who used God’s name to commit every kind of insane act. That’s why you’re dying.”
hunks.sol: “You’re a fucking lunatic who’s used God’s name to do every kind of insane shit. That’s why you’re dying.”

hunks.baseline: “You attacked civilians, kidnapped children and brainwashed them, strapped bombs to their bodies for suicide attacks… I can’t even count them one by one. There were too many.”
hunks.sol: “Attacking civilians. Kidnapping kids and brainwashing them. Strapping bombs to their bodies for suicide attacks… I can’t even list everything. There’s too much.”

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel spat, and the phlegm landed thickly on Muhammad’s face. His rough voice followed, cutting into Muhammad’s ears.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel spat. Thick phlegm stuck to Muhammad’s face, and his rough voice followed.

hunks.baseline: “So I’ll give you one last chance. You’re a fucking terrorist bastard who deserves to be tormented by Johnson all week, but if you cooperate, you’ll at least have something to say in your defense before God.”
hunks.sol: “So I’ll give you one last chance. You’re a fucking terrorist bastard who’d have no right to complain if Johnson tormented you all week. But cooperate, and maybe you’ll have something to say for yourself before God.”

hunks.baseline: “What, what does that mean?”
hunks.sol: “W-What does that mean?”

hunks.baseline: “It doesn’t mean we’re letting you live. But you might be able to die with a little less pain.”
hunks.sol: “It doesn’t mean we’re letting you live. But you might die with a little less pain.”

hunks.baseline: “We know you have countless branches under your command. We also know about the other armed terrorist organization at odds with you. The problem is that wiping them out one by one would never end. So give them orders.”
hunks.sol: “We know you have countless branches under your command. We know about the other armed terrorist organization you’re fighting, too. The problem is, rooting them out one by one would take forever. So you’re going to give your people an order.”

hunks.baseline: “Start an all-out offensive against the hostile forces right now. Fight until one side is reduced to grains of sand in the desert and crumbles away. Got it, you son of a bitch?”
hunks.sol: “Start an all-out offensive against your enemies. Right now. Keep fighting until one side crumbles into the desert sand. Got it, you son of a bitch?”

hunks.baseline: Facing Muhammad, whose eyes were wide with terror, Jin Taekyung pressed his hands together as if in prayer and added one more thing.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung pressed his palms together as if in prayer and added, “From now on, kill each other.”

hunks.baseline: “From now on, kill each other.”
Muhammad finally understood.
hunks.sol: Muhammad finally understood. He had no choices left.

hunks.baseline: He had no choices left.
Behind his refusal of this final offer waited nothing but a painful and desperate death.
hunks.sol: If he refused this final offer, all that awaited him was an agonizing, brutal death.

hunks.baseline: If I had been a reasonably popular webnovel author, I could have gotten at least five episodes out of this incident.
hunks.sol: If I’d been a reasonably popular webnovel author, I could’ve gotten at least five episodes out of this.

hunks.baseline: A power struggle between large and small armed terrorist organizations, political scenes, and various other ingredients thrown in for flavor could probably have stretched it to ten episodes.
hunks.sol: Power struggles between terrorist groups large and small, political scenes, a few other ingredients thrown in for flavor—I could probably have stretched it to ten.

hunks.baseline: But I wasn’t a webnovel author, and there were far too many terrorist groups and rebel forces that needed to be dealt with immediately.
hunks.sol: But I wasn’t a webnovel author, and there were plenty of terrorist groups and rebel forces we needed to deal with right away.

hunks.baseline: At first, we tried to deal with them quietly. But the area we had to cover was so vast and our numbers were so small that, at some point, we began receiving a warm welcome.
hunks.sol: At first, we tried to handle things quietly. But the territory was vast and there were too few of us to cover it. Before long, we started getting a warm welcome.

hunks.baseline: And the single word *enemy* included a hail of gunfire and artillery shells, along with Awakened who called themselves “warriors of God.”
hunks.sol: And that welcome included barrages of bullets and artillery shells, along with Awakened who called themselves “warriors of God.”

hunks.baseline: “Thirty million dollars immediately to whoever captures or kills them!”
hunks.sol: “Thirty million dollars, paid immediately, to whoever captures or kills them!”

hunks.baseline: As I dodged the attacks raining down from every direction, I shouted in amazement.
hunks.sol: Dodging attacks raining down from every direction, I shouted in amazement.

hunks.baseline: “I think it was ten million dollars yesterday. So this is why Luffy goes pirating!”
hunks.sol: “I think it was ten million yesterday. So *this* is why Luffy goes pirating!”

hunks.baseline: Sometimes we fought pitched battles. Other times, we swept away terrorist groups or rebel forces like stealthy visitors in the night.
hunks.sol: Sometimes we fought pitched battles. Other times, we slipped in like thieves in the night and wiped out a terrorist group or rebel force.

hunks.baseline: And in the Grand Line—no, the desert—we finally arrived at a place where a living treasure was waiting for us.
hunks.sol: And when we reached the Grand Line—no, the desert—a living treasure was waiting for us.

hunks.baseline: “Leader of the Sooni sect. Omar al-Hussein, right?”
hunks.sol: “Leader of the Sooni faction. Omar al-Hussein, right?”

hunks.baseline: “What are you talking about, you bastard who looks like Jeomsoon from the land steward’s house.”[^1]
hunks.sol: “What are you talking about, you bastard who looks like Jeomsoon from the land steward’s house?”[^2]

hunks.baseline: “Bastard…!”
hunks.sol: “You…!”

hunks.baseline: We didn’t stop.
We fought battles in dozens of regions every day, captured the leaders of terrorist groups and rebel forces, or controlled them with Magic Johnson’s custom brainwashing Magic.
hunks.sol: We didn’t stop. We fought across dozens of regions every day, capturing the leaders of terrorist groups and rebel forces or controlling them with Magic Johnson’s custom brainwashing Magic.

hunks.baseline: And just like that, a week passed in the blink of an eye.
hunks.sol: And just like that… a week passed in the blink of an eye.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: Jeomsoon is a character in Kim Yu-jeong’s short story *Spring, Spring*, the daughter of a land steward.
hunks.sol:
[^1]: *Hyojason*, the Korean word for a back scratcher, literally means “a filial son’s hand.”
[^2]: Jeomsoon is the land steward’s daughter in Kim Yu-jeong’s short story *Spring, Spring*.
